title: 2551M item 6: the TIN branch code prints three compartments, and the only valid TIN format is 3-3-3-5

subject.description: The fourth (branch-code) group of the item-6 TIN comb chain on page 1. The chain prints four boxes at x 59.76-93.84 / 98.40-131.76 / 136.08-169.44 / 174.00-207.36, all y 190.80-210.24, separated by three grey (gray 0.502) filled-and-stroked bars at x 93.60-98.64 / 131.52-136.32 / 169.20-174.24 that span the full row height. Each of the four boxes prints exactly two internal foot ticks, so the printed chain is 3+3+3+3. After the 2026-08-17 sitting the whole chain (not only this box) is reflowed to even 3-3-3-5 inside the original outer span; this printed box remains the PDF identity of the branch group.

match.strategy: the single element carrying data-field-kind="comb" whose emitted box equals printed_box_pt within tolerance_pt. The batch emits left 174.12pt width 33.24pt (174.12-207.36), which differs from the printed path box 174.00-207.36 by 0.12pt on the LEFT EDGE ONLY and by 0.00pt on the right; that is inside the tolerance and is recorded here rather than glossed, because the correction divides the EMITTED 33.24pt box and not the 33.36pt printed one.

layout_policy.inset_arithmetic: The DIVISION spans the whole 33.24pt box (boundaries 0 / 6.65 / 13.30 / 19.94 / 26.59 / 33.24). The EMITTED widths sum to 32.40pt because 0.48pt is removed at the left edge and 0.36pt at the right: 33.24 - 0.48 - 0.36 = 32.40. That is byte-for-byte the same writable extent the three-compartment emission occupies (10.20 + 11.28 + 10.92 = 32.40), so no ink-free margin is gained or lost by the correction.
layout_policy.slot_inset: none — even digit-cell width across the whole strip is the rule; re-applying per-group 0.36pt insets would squeeze the edges of each group and make the last five cells look different from the first nine
layout_policy.per_slot_input: TIN1/2/3: one editable maxlength-1 input per cell. Branch: five editable maxlength-1 inputs, each blank — no value attribute, no readonly, no tabindex override. The branch code is a value the filer supplies on this sheet.
layout_policy.note: Rounding is fixed here so the applier's output is byte-deterministic and re-computable by hand from the box width and the two insets alone.
layout_policy.branch_lock: NOT locked — the official branch box prints no 000 and no ink of any kind inside it. A locked 00000 here would declare the head office on a form whose filer must name a real branch, so the five cells stay editable. Widening 3 (or 4) compartments to 5 is the whole change; nothing is pre-filled.
layout_policy.chrome: each digit group: one outer 0.72pt frame, white knockout inside. Interior ticks are short bottom hairs (~33% of slot height), matching the official charbox (2550M month v172), not a full-height wall on every digit. Separators: dedicated SVG fill + 0.72pt black frame, no input, not in tab order.

reason: BIR's 2002 artwork for 2551M is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. It prints three compartments for the TIN branch code and, unlike 2550M, pre-prints nothing in them. Today's full TIN is a nine-digit root plus a FIVE-digit branch code, so three compartments cannot hold a branch code at all. No rule can derive 'BIR widened this field after 2002' from 2002 ink, which is precisely why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug (ARCHITECTURE.md, 'What belongs in which stage').

filing_safety.harm: The return is filed against the wrong branch, or against no branch at all. A TIN's branch code identifies the establishment the percentage-tax return belongs to; three compartments cannot hold today's five-digit code, so the code is truncated — and because this box, unlike 2550M's, pre-prints nothing, a filer can also leave it empty and file a return that names no establishment.
filing_safety.who_is_affected: Every 2551M filer whose branch code is not three digits, i.e. any registered branch numbered above 999 (four or five digits) and any head office filing the modern 00000. They have no way to enter it on today's form at all.
filing_safety.today: Three empty compartments, all typeable, no pre-printed constant: the filer can enter at most three characters and can enter none.
filing_safety.after: Five compartments over the same box; a four- or five-digit branch code becomes enterable, and the head-office 00000 becomes representable.
